title: Silver/gold customer data published to a public Hugging Face dataset every 4 hours
detail: orchestrate.yml:90 uploads data/lake (six silver/gold Parquet incl. customer_id, email_hash, iban_hash) to swadhinbiswas/eustream; HF API shows private=false, gated=false, modified 2026-11-05.

conflicts.note: No code path transfers data outside the EU

meaning: Pseudonymised customer records are downloadable by anyone, on a host not pinned to the EU
impact: Stop the upload before migrating; the target export must go to a governed share (Delta Sharing) not a public repo
risk: Pseudonymised data is still personal data under GDPR; public exposure and residency breach

recommendation.reason: Upload step read and public flag observed live; verified by an independent check

title: API has no authentication; erasure and customer data endpoints are open
detail: No auth dependency on any FastAPI route; CORS allows all origins with credentials (api.py:52). POST /erase/{id}, POST /erasure-requests, GET /gold/customer-360, /governance/erasure-audit are open; Render serves it publicly.

conflicts.note: Put it behind your gateway/SSO before exposing /erasure-requests

meaning: Anyone who knows the URL can erase any customer or read customer profiles
impact: Serving layer must be replaced (Databricks App or SQL with UC permissions) not re-pointed as is
risk: Malicious mass erasure or data exfiltration on the hosted copy today

recommendation.reason: Grep finds no auth; independently verified

title: SQL injection in GET /verify-erasure/{customer_id}
detail: Five SQL strings interpolate the raw path parameter in quotes (api.py:239-251) and run against the warehouse; endpoint is unauthenticated.

evidence.excerpt: f"SELECT count(*) FROM gold.customer_360 WHERE customer_id='{customer_id}'"

meaning: A crafted customer id can run arbitrary SQL on the warehouse
impact: Do not port the endpoint; parameterise or replace
risk: Data read or tampering through a public URL

title: PII salt defaults to a value published in source code
detail: config.py:22 PII_SALT literal is the default for pii_salt (config.py:83); docker-compose sets no salt, so containers hash with the public value. DEV pipeline reads the salt from a secret scope.
meaning: Hashed emails and IBANs may be reversible by anyone who reads the repo
impact: Target must fail closed without a secret salt; data hashed with the default may need re-keying
risk: Combined with FND-01, published hashes are re-identifiable by dictionary attack

title: Erasure never reaches the event bus, Turso failures or the published lake
detail: Erasure touches warehouse tables only (erasure.py:190-238); bus messages/topics keep raw email/IBAN/IP, Turso errors are swallowed (erasure.py:237), HF history keeps old Parquet versions.

evidence.excerpt: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (

meaning: A customer 'erased' today still exists in at least four other stores
impact: Target erasure must cover bronze history (VACUUM), Kafka retention, exports and shares; legacy stores need a purge before decommission
risk: Art. 17 non-compliance carried into and around the new platform

recommendation.reason: Cascade read in full; independently verified for the bus

title: Erasure audit claims the lake was erased before it is
detail: 'lake' is added to layers_touched whenever a hook exists (erasure.py:122) and status stays 'completed' when the hook fails (erasure.py:157).
meaning: The erasure certificate can be false
impact: Target audit must record verified outcomes per store (DEV job has verify tasks to reuse)
risk: Wrong evidence handed to a data subject or regulator

title: Late-arriving events permanently skipped by the incremental silver run
detail: Watermark = max(bronze.orders.occurred_at) (warehouse.py:687-690), applied to orders (670) and payments (682); no lookback, events at or below the watermark never reach silver.
meaning: Some orders and payments silently never appear in reports
impact: Target uses streaming tables or checkpointed ingestion; reconciliation must expect bronze>silver today
risk: Reconciliation between legacy and target will not match; revenue under-reported

title: DEV workspace runs a EuroStream bundle whose source is no longer in the repo
detail: DEV has 4 eurostream_* jobs and 3 serverless pipelines (catalog eurostream) deployed by bundle on 2026-09-28; commit c78138d removed databricks/ on 2026-10-08.
meaning: A first Databricks version exists and runs, but nobody can review or redeploy it from source
impact: Recover the bundle source (git history or workspace export) before planning; it may cut migration effort
risk: Team rebuilds what exists, or overwrites DEV with a different design

recommendation.reason: Observed live and in git history

title: DEV metastore is in us-east-2 while documents require EU residency
detail: Live read: metastore region us-east-2 (posture VX-RES-1). ADR-0001 pins all storage and processing to EU regions.

evidence.excerpt: All storage and processing is pinned to EU regions:

meaning: The target workspace stores data outside the EU
impact: Production target must be an EU-region workspace/metastore; DEV is fine only with synthetic data
risk: Real customer data landing in DEV breaches the residency decision

recommendation.reason: Observed live; consent file says test data only

title: Malformed events dropped with no count at bronze; fraud alerts duplicate on retry
detail: load_bronze_from_records discards parse/validation failures (warehouse.py:397,403). bronze.fraud_alerts has no key, and alerts are produced before the offset commit (streaming.py:269), so replays duplicate alerts.
meaning: Some events are lost and some alerts double-counted without anyone knowing
impact: Target: quarantine via expectations, dedup alerts by a deterministic key
risk: Fraud counts and event totals differ between systems during parallel run

title: Gold customer_360 includes non-consenting customers
detail: build_gold inserts every silver customer with no consent filter (warehouse.py:545-561); RFC promises no non-consenting customer in marketing aggregates; the table is exported publicly (FND-01).

conflicts.note: no non-consenting customer flows into marketing-facing aggregates

meaning: Marketing-facing data may include people who refused consent
impact: Target gold needs a consent-gated view or UC row filter
risk: Consent breach (GDPR Art. 6/7) if marketing reads the table

recommendation.reason: Code verified; whether marketing reads it is OQ-07

title: CI and tests still target the removed databricks/ folder
detail: ci.yml:36 databricks-app job and tests/databricks/* read databricks/ which does not exist, so CI fails on every push.
meaning: The build is red, so no change is protected by CI
impact: Restore the source (FND-11) or remove the jobs/tests before migration work starts
risk: Regressions slip in during migration with no working gate

title: API opens stores at import and shares one DuckDB connection across requests
detail: app = bootstrap() runs at import (api.py:644): opens the bus, warehouse, Turso and an erasure consumer; one duckdb connection (warehouse.py:123) is used by all threadpooled requests without a lock.
meaning: Importing the API touches real data; concurrent requests share one connection
impact: Serving rewrite on the target removes this; no conversion
risk: Corrupt reads or crashes under load on the hosted copy

recommendation.reason: Read in code; not reproduced (no run possible)

title: Hidden fallbacks: empty reads go to Turso, empty stats go to the public HF lake
detail: Warehouse.query/scalar retry on Turso when empty (warehouse.py:829); /stats reads hf://datasets/swadhinbiswas/eustream when local is 0 (api.py:141); /fraud_alerts falls back to gold.fraud_summary.
meaning: Users can see erased, stale or third-party numbers presented as live
impact: Do not reproduce; reconciliation must compare against DuckDB only
risk: Parallel-run comparisons pick up Turso/HF values and look wrong

title: Fraud scorer state is in memory; checkpoint is not atomic nor tied to offsets
detail: State lives in dicts (streaming.py:71); checkpoint claims exactly-once (streaming.py:163) but is a plain file write not coordinated with commit.

evidence.excerpt: """Persist state like Flink checkpointing — enables exactly-once recovery."""

meaning: A restart forgets recent payment history and may skip or repeat alerts
impact: Rewrite as Structured Streaming stateful operator with checkpointing (resolved by target)
risk: Low if rewritten; high if the class is lifted as a UDF

title: Warehouse and bus files with PII cached in GitHub Actions; repo pushed to a personal HF Space
detail: orchestrate.yml:21-23 caches data/eurocart.duckdb and data/events.db; deploy-space.yml:44 uploads the repo to swadhinbiswas/eurostream without excluding governance/ or infra/.
meaning: Copies of raw customer data live in CI caches and on a personal account
impact: Purge caches and Space when the legacy stack is retired
risk: Uncontrolled copies outside any erasure or residency scope

title: DuckDB/SQLite-specific SQL and full rebuilds need rewriting, not transpiling
detail: INSERT OR IGNORE/REPLACE, arg_max, bool_and, COPY TO PARQUET, read_parquet('hf://'), DELETE-then-INSERT full rebuilds (warehouse.py:477,541) without transactions.

evidence.excerpt: def build_silver(self, pii_salt: str = PII_SALT) -> None:

meaning: The transformation code cannot be moved as is
impact: Silver/gold become declarative pipelines (DEV already has them); estimate as rewrite
risk: A failed mid-run rebuild leaves empty tables today

title: DEV erasure job ends with failures in 3 of its last 5 runs
detail: eurostream_art17_erasure last 5 runs: 2 SUCCESS, 3 SUCCESS_WITH_FAILURES (2026-09-28). Task-level cause not read.
meaning: The Databricks erasure prototype is not yet reliable
impact: Treat it as a starting point; its failing tasks need diagnosis
risk: Assuming the DEV erasure works understates effort

title: Assessment service principal cannot see the eurostream catalog
detail: catalogs list as workspace-assessor returns workspace, sat, system, samples only; the pipelines write to catalog eurostream, so tables, grants and lineage were not inventoried.
meaning: The DEV data layer is invisible to the assessment identity
impact: Grant USE CATALOG + BROWSE on eurostream to the SP for the next run
risk: DEV table inventory and grants stay unknown in this report

title: PII-in-clear gate samples only 50 rows; manifest misses payments.iban and clicks.ip_address
detail: quality.py:87 LIMIT 50; governance/pii_manifest.json registers only bronze.orders email/iban.

evidence.excerpt: f"SELECT {col} FROM {table} WHERE {col} IS NOT NULL LIMIT 50"

meaning: Personal data can slip past the controls meant to catch it
impact: Replace with UC classification and tags plus full-column expectations
risk: Untagged PII escapes masking on the target
